data.title: Stafford Municipal School District
data.lede: First district in the region to build a dedicated esports facility. Home of the Stafford Spartans.

quote.text: TANCHES.GG has been an outstanding technology sponsor for Stafford MSD’s esports program. Their partnership and support have played an important role in our students’ success and growth. We’re grateful for their commitment to helping our esports program thrive.

data.storyTitle: A full-facility esports lab, built from scratch.

story.label: OBJECTIVE
paras: Stafford Municipal School District knew what they wanted to build. They saw where esports and STEM were heading and set out to get their students there first. No other district in the region had created an esports facility at the time, and SMSD’s leadership had done the homework to know it was worth doing, and worth doing right.

They also knew a build at this level goes best as a collaboration, so they turned to a partner they already trusted. TanChes had supported SMSD’s IT and technology infrastructure for years, and when the district set its sights on esports, they came to us to see if we could help bring it to life. We worked alongside the district’s team from the start, aligned on their goals for the program, and then designed, procured, and deployed the facility utilizing DIR and OMNIA contracts. That kept the entire project under one contract and took the burden of a standalone bid off the district’s plate.

story.label: OVERVIEW
paras: The result is an esports lab tied to STEM education, and we built every layer of it. We brought in an electrician for the electrical work and ran the structured cabling throughout the facility ourselves, placing data drops and power where the room needed them, then set up a fast, low-latency network made for competitive play. We sourced and deployed the full hardware lineup, working alongside Dell/Alienware, MSI, Samsung, and others to bring added resources to the program, and researched grants to help fund what comes next. After go-live, we stayed on for ongoing support and maintenance, so the lab keeps performing and the district always has someone to call.

data.pull: SMSD set the direction, and we delivered the build to match it. First in the region, and built to scale from here.

delivered.title: Consulting & Program Approval
delivered.body: SMSD’s Superintendent and STEM Director already had esports on their radar. We consulted with them and their IT Director on the technology side, helping shape what the program would need as they aligned it with their STEM goals and carried it through to district leadership approval.

delivered.title: Electrical & Structured Cabling
delivered.body: We worked with their electrician on the electrical work and handled the structured cabling throughout the facility ourselves, placing data drops and power connections for performance and ease of use.

delivered.title: Hardware Procurement
delivered.body: We sourced and deployed the full gaming hardware lineup via DIR and OMNIA state purchasing contracts: high-end PCs, monitors, gaming consoles, peripherals, and professional-grade displays. The centerpiece is white Alienware Aurora R13 gaming stations with matching white peripherals, RGB-backlit mechanical keyboards, precision gaming mice, and high-refresh-rate monitors.

delivered.title: Network Setup
delivered.body: We designed and set up a fast, low-latency network built for competitive play, with room to scale as the program grows.

delivered.title: Grants Research
delivered.body: We researched K-12 ed-tech and esports grants to help SMSD fund what comes next for the program.

delivered.title: Vendor Liaison
delivered.body: We connected SMSD with manufacturer partners including Dell/Alienware, MSI, and Samsung, opening up added resources and support tailored to the program.

delivered.title: After-Sales Support & Ongoing Maintenance
delivered.body: We stayed on after go-live for troubleshooting, system updates, and regular maintenance, so the lab keeps performing and the district always has someone to call.

features.title: Custom esports facility
features.body: From planning to execution, we built a space where students practice, compete, and work together.

features.title: Integrated technology
features.body: Equipped with the latest hardware and software, ensuring a high-performance environment for esports.

features.title: Future-proof design
features.body: Built with scalability in mind, ready to adapt to future tech and learning needs.

data.title: City of Muskogee
data.lede: Lenovo Legion gaming PCs for the Muskogee Esports Arena, sourced and shipped within a week while the rest of the market was out of stock.

quote.role: Director of Esports · City of Muskogee
quote.text: The difference was obvious from day one. Better communication, faster answers, and better service than we’ve had from any vendor. TANCHES.GG treats our program like it’s their own.

data.storyTitle: The right machines, when no one had them.

story.label: OBJECTIVE
paras: The City of Muskogee was opening the Muskogee Esports Arena, a public gaming space for the community. The room, the furniture, and the branding were taking shape. What the arena still needed was the machines to run it, and it needed them fast.

story.label: CHALLENGE
paras: The timing could not have been worse. NVIDIA was transitioning to its RTX 50 Series GPUs, and previous-generation inventory was clearing out faster than new cards could arrive. At the same time, an industry-wide chip shortage was squeezing supply at every tier. Gaming PCs that would normally ship in days were backordered for weeks, or gone entirely.

story.label: APPROACH
paras: Because the purchase was open market, we were not tied to a single contract catalog. We went straight to our manufacturer and distribution relationships, found allocation on Lenovo Legion gaming desktops, and pushed the order through on an expedited timeline. The full order shipped within a week.

data.pull: Out of stock everywhere. Shipped in a week.

delivered.title: Open-Market Sourcing
delivered.body: With no contract vehicle in play, we searched across our manufacturer and distribution channels to find inventory that actually existed, not just inventory on paper.

delivered.title: Lenovo Legion Gaming Desktops
delivered.body: Lenovo Legion towers built for competitive play, ready to power every station in the arena.

delivered.title: Expedited Fulfillment
delivered.body: We secured allocation and expedited the order through the supply chain, shipping the full order within a week of purchase.

result.sub: During a GPU generation change and an industry-wide chip shortage.

features.title: Sourced in a dry market
features.body: While distributors were backordered, we located real Legion allocation and locked it in.

features.title: Full order fulfilled
features.body: Every machine on the order shipped within the week.

features.title: Open-market flexibility
features.body: No contract catalog to wait on, so we could go wherever the inventory was.
